Privacy Rights Request

Subgraph Inc respects your privacy rights. Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and other applicable privacy laws, you may have the right to:

Delete your personal information
Correct inaccurate personal information
Know what personal information is being collected and access that information
Know what personal information is being sold or shared and to whom
Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information
Limit the use and disclosure of sensitive personal information
Submit a Request
